seo.description: Residential and commercial interior design, bespoke joinery, renovation, lighting design and 3D visualisation — from Woodex Interior, Lahore.

data.title: Everything between the first sketch and the last cushion
data.text: Six services, one team. Combine them or start with the one you need.

data.title: How a project runs
data.text: Clear stages, clear deliverables, and a decision point at the end of each.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.text: We visit the site, agree the brief and budget, and confirm the programme.

steps.title: Concept
steps.text: Layout options, mood boards and a first material palette for your approval.

steps.title: Design development
steps.text: Detailed drawings, joinery, lighting, finishes schedule and renders.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: Workshop production, site coordination, styling and handover.

data.title: Three ways to start
data.text: Fees are fixed per stage and confirmed in writing before we begin.
data.note: All packages include a written scope, itemised allowances and a named project lead. *Prices exclude construction and furniture.*

plans.name: Consultation
plans.text: A two-hour on-site session with a written summary of recommendations.

plans.name: Design package
plans.text: Complete design and documentation for a room, floor or whole home.

plans.name: Turnkey
plans.text: Design, build, joinery and styling delivered by one accountable team.

items.q: How early should we involve you?
items.a: Before walls move. The best results — and the lowest costs — come when interiors, lighting and joinery are planned alongside the architecture.

items.q: Can you work with our contractor?
items.a: Yes. We supply drawings detailed enough for any competent contractor and supervise their work, or deliver turnkey with our own team.
We do — architects and designers commission kitchens, wardrobes and furniture from their own drawings.

items.q: What does a typical residential timeline look like?
items.a: Around 10–20 weeks from concept to handover depending on scope. Renovations with structural work run longer.
Across Pakistan for design and turnkey, and internationally for design and visualisation packages.
